gate.metric: mean cosine of the top-n retrieved neighbours vs the query
gate.fallback: C = zeros(256) when the gate rejects a query

arms.a: gated memory (C only when the gate trusts the retrieval)

best.rule: highest mean eval cos over the memory-active checkpoints (step > auto_fit_after), pre-registered

paired_tests_at_best.note: paired t over the 500 eval pairs; consecutive sentences from one document are correlated, so this mildly overstates significance

caveat_memory_vs_model: the eval pairs are held out from the MEMORY, not from the model: TASK 27 trained the predictor on all 7,666 val pairs, including these. All arms share the frozen predictor, so every delta is a clean memory effect.
